messages:
Ibrahim H.: heads up — after the RBAC tidy landed at ~02:30 UTC our nightly "lint-scan" job and a bunch of SAST checks started failing. DAST also bubbled KMS:PermissionDenied on artifact decryption. audit export shows a short hole.

Ibrahim H.: sample error:
```
2026-02-14T02:30:11Z lint-scan: owner-index lookup: 404 NotFound (index-missing)
2026-02-14T02:30:12Z sast: ownership-check: git read: 403 Forbidden
2026-02-14T02:30:13Z dast: decrypt artifact: KMS PermissionDenied key projects/redwood-inference/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/artifact-v2
```

Clara W.: cc @sec-oncall @owner-indexer 1 which TF change was applied? I merged a cleanup that removed a couple broad group bindings and swapped in scoped groups. I did not explicitly touch scanner SA binds.

deploy-bot: terraform: apply complete. Changes: remove group:ci-broad-write, update iam_binding for group:scoped-ci-ops, remove direct binding for sa:code-lint@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com (expected to be covered by group).

owner-indexer: The owner-index service depends on source.reader + repo:blame permissions. If it can't access repo metadata it returns an index miss which our lint-scan treats as ownerless. Also scanning pipeline queries KMS to unwrap signed artifacts; if decrypt fails we bail.

sec-oncall: collect the exact audit window and request ids. If there's a gap in audit logs include that in a cloud support case. Also check whether the scanner was using an ephemeral wrapped key (we've seen rotations orphan wrapped keys before).

Ibrahim H.: Gap I see between 2026-02-14T02:29:58Z and 2026-02-14T02:31:30Z. Request IDs near window: rq-omega-21, rq-omega-22. Exporting logs now to gs://sec-exports/1807778888/partial/.
audit-bot: export complete (partial): gs://sec-exports/1807778888/partial/ (files: export-1.json, export-2.json)

Clara W.: quick mitigation: re-grant explicit bindings to the scanner identities and the owner-indexer service account. Commands used:
```
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-inference \\
  --member=serviceAccount:code-lint@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com \\
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-inference \\
  --member=serviceAccount:owner-indexer@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com \\
  --role=roles/source.reader
```

deploy-bot: IAM bindings updated.

Ibrahim H.: re-ran affected pipelines. Most DASTs and lint-scan runs recovered; SAST still flags ~9 PRs as ownerless due to owner-index returning 5xx during the incident and cache TTL keeping stale state.

owner-indexer: I flushed the index cache for the monorepo and restarted the indexer. There was an error: indexer couldn't access a few repos because group membership change made their project-level binding inconsistent.

Clara W.: we pinned the terraform module to keep the explicit bindings for now and added a note to the change set to verify critical SAs before broad consolidations. Pushing a small TF change to restore the bindings in state.

sec-oncall: short-term pipeline change recommended: treat owner-indexer 5xx/timeouts as non-blocking and fall back to parsing in-repo CODEOWNERS with label OWNER:inferred (do not block merges). Please make that feature-flagged and emit a metric when fallback is used.

Ibrahim H.: agreed. I'll open PR owner-fallback behind flag owner_fallback=true and add a dashboard panel for fallback-rate. Also opening incident tickets for followups.

payments-lead: our payments PRs are affected 1 we'll wait for the green. Ping when most checks are clear.

Clara W.: action items I'm creating: 1) INFRA-937 rehydrate-scanner-bindings (assign infra) 2) SEC-820 owner-fallback-pipeline (assign Ibrahim) 3) SEC-821 audit-log-forensics (assign sec-oncall). I'll attach the gcloud commands and the terraform plan diff.

sec-oncall: escalate to cloud support if audit logs can't be reconstructed from the export. Provide request IDs rq-omega-21/rq-omega-22, sink name sec-audit and exact window. Also add runbook step: during KMS key rotations keep temporary decrypt grants for consumers until validated.

owner-indexer: follow-ups: 1) add resiliency to indexer so index misses don't hard-fail scans, 2) surface human-readable fallback reasons on PR checks, 3) add unit test simulating group-removal + indexer outage.

Ibrahim H.: drafting postmortem with timeline, commands, and detection/mitigation notes. Posting draft to #incidents and linking SEC tickets.

Clara W.: I'll coordinate to remove the temporary explicit bindings once we have a pre-apply checklist and automated verification in CI.

sec-oncall: :thumbsup: keep this thread updated with cloud case number and ticket links. Thanks all.
